assembly_notes: Install rails and clamps to the roof structure per the module and mounting-system specifications, maintaining required clearances and torque.
Mount modules without stressing the glass; connect only compatible, correctly polarized PV-rated connectors and secure cable runs.
Install DC isolator, AC protection/disconnect, grid-tie inverter, and battery inverter/charger to applicable electrical and grid requirements.
Commission and function-test inverter, MPPT, protections, battery management, charging, and grid interaction; record test results.
Handle the battery per its manufacturer’s instructions; ship battery cells by sea only as UN3481 packed with equipment.
